posts.subject: Display-Port-Verbindung funktioniert nicht mehr LEGION T5 26IRX9 mit Monitor Lenovo Legion R25i-30
posts.author: petergottstein
posts.message_html:
After now 6 months of operation with an external monitor (Lenovo Legion R25i-30) connected to my Lenovo PC via DisplayPort cable (no docking station in between!), the display suddenly stopped working. It seems as if the connection on the PC (or on the monitor) is no longer functioning. Both devices, PC and monitor, are 6 months old.

However, the connection via HDMI cable works.

I have tried: bought and connected a new DisplayPort cable, restarted over 10 times. No change.

Apparently, no updates have been installed in the last few weeks, so that shouldn't be the issue either.

What else can I try?

posts.subject: Re:DisplayPort connection no longer works LEGION T5 26IRX9 with Lenovo Legion R25i-30 monitor
posts.author: Hassen_Lenovo
posts.message_html:
Hi petergottstein,

Thank you for reaching out to the Lenovo Community. I'm sorry to hear about the issues you're experiencing with your DisplayPort connection. Is the monitor detected at all in Windows when connected via DP? (Check under Display Settings > Multiple Displays or Device Manager > Monitors.) Let's try a few troubleshooting steps to resolve this issue:

  1. Check Display Settings: Ensure that the monitor is set to the correct input source (DisplayPort) and that the display settings on your PC are configured to use the external monitor.

  2. Update Graphics Drivers: Sometimes, outdated or corrupted graphics drivers can cause connectivity issues. Use the Lenovo Vantage App to check for and install any available updates for your system.

  3. Test with Another Device: If possible, connect your monitor to another device using the DisplayPort cable to determine if the issue is with the monitor or the PC.

  4. Inspect Ports: Carefully inspect the DisplayPort on both the PC and the monitor for any visible damage or debris that might be obstructing the connection.

  5. Reset Monitor Settings: Try resetting your monitor to its factory settings. This can sometimes resolve connectivity issues.

I hope this helps! Please let us know if you have any further questions.

Best regards,

Hassen_Lenovo

topic_info.subject: Display-Port-Verbindung funktioniert nicht mehr LEGION T5 26IRX9 mit Monitor Lenovo Legion R25i-30
topic_info.message:
Nach nun 6 Monaten Betrieb mit externem Monitor (Lenovo Legion R25i-30) an meinem Lenovo PC mittels Display Port Kabel (keine Dockingstation dazwischen!) funktionierte plötzlich das Bild nicht mehr. Es scheint als ob der Anschluss am PC (oder am Bildschirm) nicht mehr funktioniert. Beide Geräte, PC und Monitor, sind 6 Monate jung.

Die Verbindung per HDMI-Kabel funktioniert jedoch.

Ich habe ausprobiert: Neues Display Port Kabel gekauft und angeschlossen, über 10 Mal neu gestartet. Keine Veränderung. 

Scheinbar wurden in den letzten Wochen auch keinerlei Updates installiert, daran kann es also auch eigentlich auch nicht liegen.

Was kann ich noch ausprobieren?
